strategy.primary: Artifact stax-combo: run symmetrical artifact-spell counters (Void Mirror, Chalice of the Void, Blood Funnel, Nether Void, Nullstone Gargoyle, Possibility Storm, Vexing Bauble, Planar Chaos) that only Mishra breaks. His cast trigger can put the countered or exiled card back onto the battlefield from graveyard or library, so the stax hurts opponents only.
strategy.secondary: Fast artifact mana and tutors assemble commander-free artifact kills: Sensei's Divining Top with Mystic Forge or The Reality Chip, KCI + Scrap Trawler + Myr Retriever, Karn + Aetherflux, or the Karn/Vandalblast + Mycosynth Lattice lock.

commander_oracle_snapshots.name: Mishra, Artificer Prodigy
commander_oracle_snapshots.oracle_text: Whenever you cast an artifact spell, you may search your graveyard, hand, and/or library for a card with the same name as that spell and put it onto the battlefield. If you search your library this way, shuffle.

identity.why: Turns countered artifact spells into free permanents.
Counters opponents' colorless spells; Mishra recovers his own.
The strongest identity card according to the source.
